name: Paws at You AI
tagline: Your pet walks up and boops the camera
description: Paws at You AI turns one photo of your dog, cat, or other pet into a short vertical video inspired by the viral "paws at you" snow leopard meme: your own pet walks up and presses a paw on the lens. There is no prompt to write. The Paws at you template is a 5-second 9:16 clip; Santa paws adds a Santa hat and a gift by the tree, then the same boop. Every account gets one free 480p preview with a pawsatyouai.com watermark (no card). Full-quality 720p downloads with no watermark use one credit each. One-time packs are $6.90 / 1, $9.90 / 2, and $19.90 / 5, with no subscription; a failed render returns the credit. Motion and likeness vary. It does not turn your pet into a snow leopard, and it is not affiliated with the meme's creators or with other sites of a similar name. Independent service at pawsatyouai.com.
